goal: Implement the next step of the benchmark: build step 5, the bench harness that runs trials on generated devices

escalation.reason: 02-B12 cannot be met as written. It says deleting or replacing the truth file once a trial's run has started changes neither grade nor seal, but the Spec makes evaluator.accepted_driver the only caller passing check_truth=False. adapters.adapter_for calls resolve_case with the default at every stage and package call, so with real stages an earlier change stops the run with IntegrityError: Case truth hash mismatch (outcome_category integrity), and it is never graded. Options: (a) adapter_for also passes check_truth=False and the 'only caller' sentence is amended; (b) narrow B12 to once the stages have ended and accept an earlier change as an integrity stop. All other Behaviours are built with a green full suite (1473 tests); nothing is committed.
